## Calculate confidence intervals for CDF

```{r}
sdl_EWR_ecdf <- sdl_EWR_timeseries|>
  ungroup()|>
  select(-year)|>
  group_by(Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, scenario)|> #YES SCENARIO!
  mutate(ewr_achieved_group = round(ewr_achieved, 2))|>
  arrange(ewr_achieved)|>  
  mutate(ecdf_val = ecdf(ewr_achieved)(ewr_achieved))|>
  tibble()|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_achieved_group)|> #NOT SCENARIO!
  mutate(ecdf_mean = mean(ecdf_val),
         cdf_lsd = ecdf_mean - 2*sd(ecdf_val),
         cdf_usd = ecdf_mean + 2*sd(ecdf_val))

# 
# temp <- quantreg::rq(sdl_EWR_timeseries, tau = 0.95)
# quantile(95)
```

## MAP

```{r}
gauges_df <- get_ewr_gauges()|>
  #st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(OWNER = case_when(owner == "NSW - NSW Department of Industry – Lands and Water" ~ "NSW",
                           owner == "VIC - Department of Environment, Land, Water and Planning"~ "VIC",
                           owner == "SA - Department of Environment, Water and Natural Resources"~ "SA",
                           owner == "QLD - Department of Natural Resources, Mines and Energy"~ "QLD",
                           owner == NA ~ NA))

Map_Macquarie <- ggplot(data = sdl_units,  aes(geometry = geometry)) +
  geom_sf(fill = "white")+
  geom_sf(data = filter(gauges_df, gauge %in% gauges_to_plot),  aes(geometry = geometry), colour = "#fcaa20")+
  geom_sf(data = filter(sdl_units, SWSDLName == SWSDLName_subset),  aes(geometry = geometry), fill = "#fcaa20", colour = "#fcaa20", alpha = 0.1)+ 
  geom_sf_text(data = filter(sdl_units, SWSDLName == SWSDLName_subset), aes(label = SWSDLName), colour = "#fcaa20") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme_werp_toolkit(legend.position = "none")
```

## NULL DATA

```{r}

null_data <- data.frame(
  ewr_achieved = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.01),
  ewr_code = "CF",
  env_group = "NF",
  Data = "Null model")

null_data <- null_data |>
  mutate(n_years_achieved = 130*ewr_achieved,
         n_years_not_achieved = 130*(1-ewr_achieved),
         mean_max_interevent = n_years_not_achieved/n_years_achieved)|>
  mutate(mean_max_interevent = ifelse(mean_max_interevent == Inf, 130, mean_max_interevent),
         Data = "Stochastic")

null_data1 <- null_data
null_data1$Data <- "Historic"

null_data <- bind_rows(null_data, null_data1)

```

```{r}
                                    info_list = aggregation_info,
                                    mark = "all",#'MACQ_CC_EFR_mkiv', 
                                    licvol = 'licvolfactor_1_0',
                                    climate = "all",#'r1_0_e1_0',
                                    aggname = 'sdl_ewr_spells')

sdl_EWR_spells <- filter(sdl_EWR_spells, !grepl("MAX", scenario))

sdl_target_spells <- read_in_aggs(project_dir = project_dir,
                                    data_type = c('stochastic', 'historical'),
                                    info_list = aggregation_info,
                                    mark = "all",#'MACQ_CC_EFR_mkiv', 
                                    licvol = 'licvolfactor_1_0',
                                    climate = "all",#'r1_0_e1_0',
                                    aggname = 'sdl_target_spells')

sdl_target_spells <- filter(sdl_target_spells, !grepl("MAX", scenario))

plot_sdl_EWR_variability_sh_management <- ggplot() + 
  geom_violin(data = filter(sdl_EWR_spells, Data == "Stochastic" & Mark == "Mk4a"), aes(y = ewr_achieved, x = ewr_code, group = ewr_code, scale = "width"),
              colour = "grey") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(sdl_EWR_spells, Data == "Historic"), 
              aes(y = ewr_achieved, x = ewr_code, group = ewr_code, alpha = Mark, shape = Data, fill = names_CSIRO_climate_scenario), 
             size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = filter(sdl_EWR_spells, Data == "Historic"), 
              aes(y = ewr_achieved, x = ewr_code, group = ewr_code, shape = Data), 
             size = 3) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_EWR)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_CSIRO_climate_scenario)+
  #scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_data)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_data)+
  theme_werp_toolkit()+
  #theme(legend.box = "horizontal")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21)),
         colour=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21)),
         alpha=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21)))+
  facet_wrap(~names_CSIRO_climate_scenario, nrow = 1)

plot_sdl_target_variability_sh_management <- ggplot() +  
  geom_violin(data = filter(sdl_target_spells, Data == "Stochastic" & Mark == "Mk4a"), aes(y = ewr_achieved, x = env_group, group = env_group),
              colour = "grey") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(sdl_target_spells, Data == "Historic"), 
              aes(y = ewr_achieved, x = env_group, group = env_group, alpha = Mark, shape = Data, fill = names_CSIRO_climate_scenario),
             size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = filter(sdl_target_spells, Data == "Historic"), 
              aes(y = ewr_achieved, x = env_group, group = env_group, shape = Data),
             size = 3) +
  #geom_boxplot() +
  theme_werp_toolkit()+
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_envgroup)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_CSIRO_climate_scenario)+
  #scale_linetype_manual(values = linetype_data)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_data)+
  #theme(legend.box = "horizontal")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21)),
         colour=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21)))+
  facet_wrap(~names_CSIRO_climate_scenario)

ggsave(plot = plot_sdl_EWR_variability_sh_management, filename = file.path(comp_results, paste0("plot_sdl_EWR_variability_stoch_and_historic_climatechange_management",Sys.Date(),".tiff")), device = "tiff", width = 10, height = 8)

ggsave(plot = plot_sdl_target_variability_sh_management, filename = file.path(comp_results, paste0("plot_sdl_target_variability_stoch_and_historic_climatechange_management",Sys.Date(),".tiff")), device = "tiff", width = 10, height = 8)
```
